summary: The note describes Koondra Land District, a cadastral land district in Western Australia. It is a subdivision of the North-West Land Division and lies in the Pilbara region of the state.
one_line: Koondra Land District is a cadastral land district in the Pilbara region of Western Australia, within the North-West Land Division.
key_facts: Koondra Land District is a land district (cadastral division) of Western Australia.
Koondra Land District is a subdivision of the North-West Land Division.
Koondra Land District is located in the Pilbara region of Western Australia.
